name: sm-no-saccade-style-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the sm-no-saccade-style JavaScript and PHP linters.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:php
scripts.lint:js: npm --workspace sm-no-saccade-style run lint && eslint --config packages/js/eslint.config.js scripts/*.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:php
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage:js && npm run coverage:php
scripts.release:npm:trust: npx --yes npm@^11.5.1 trust github sm-no-saccade-style --repository seanmorris/sm-no-saccade-style --file publish-npm.yml --allow-publish
